flows.flow: canonical names, owned/equipped/locked and exhausted stock
real capsule pickup, conditional weapon preview and separate trial stock
secondary-touch skill selection cancels FIRE and BLINK consumes only on teleport
long preview acknowledgement followed by first-tap selection
stage-specific entry previews, automatic loop and persistent v3 acknowledgements
conditional first introduction of selected equipped weapon

method: Real headless Chromium controls, mouse holds, compositor-generated secondary touch, actual cannon/pickup/CPU cycles, long-hold preview and save/reload. Unlocks and stage selection are controlled fixtures; one authored capsule trajectory is selected with shared physics. No production handler invocation, simulated wins, physical-device or human-comprehension claim.
